## Description

Azure Data Factory with a self-hosted integration runtime on a clinic PC (outbound only, no open ports), read-only DB user, encrypted transfer into a raw staging schema in-country. Connectors: Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, CSV/Excel upload. Source connection registered per migration project.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Connection requires only outbound connectivity from the clinic; no inbound firewall changes.
- [ ] **AC2.** The source database user is read-only (verified by attempting a write that fails).
- [ ] **AC3.** Raw data lands in the in-country staging area, encrypted, isolated per tenant, with retention limits.
- [ ] **AC4.** Connection test and inventory (tables, row counts) are shown to operations.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
